newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys 520,000 tonnes of diesel for December.
newsitem.headline: India buys 520,000 tonnes of diesel for December.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought by tender 520,000 tonnes of high-speed diesel in 13 cargoes for delivery in December, traders said on Monday.
They said seven cargoes would be for delivery to the east coast ports of Madras or Haldia, four would be for the east coast ports of Goa or Kandla, and two cargoes are on a free-on-board (FOB) basis.

All but one cargo has a sulphur content of one percent. The remaining cargo has 0.5 percent sulphur content. Traders said the volume awarded was within market expectations of between 500,000 to 600,000 tonnes.
On Friday, the swaps market had already moved up on these expectations.
The details of the awards are as follows:

Elf Trading - 75 cents per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes FOB; $2.08 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes cost and freight (C and F) east coast; $2.08 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes C and F west coast.
BB Energy - $1.87 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes C and F west coast (two cargoes).
Cargill - $1.96 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes C and F west coast (one cargo).
Shell - $2.2 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes C and F east coast (one cargo); $2.76-2.81 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes C and F west coast (three cargoes).
Mobil - $2.59 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes C and F east coast (two cargoes).
Kuwait Petroleum Corp - $1.15 per barrel premium to Mideast spot quotes FOB.
India cancelled its previous tender for November delivery.
